messages:
inc-bot: INCIDENT alert: p99 latency breach detected for /v1/streaming/generate in us-west-2 (SLO p99=600ms, observed ~1.4s). Root cause suspected: router misrouting -> hot partitioning / policy skew. Paging on-call (@Alex@here).

Alex: reading it now. seeing p95 ~480ms but p99 ~1.35s, streaming stalls flagged by the ingest trace sampler. Paging SRE.

Maria: confirmed, dashboard -> router tail latency spike aligns with a surge of requests to shard region-usw2-044. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/latency/usw2 -> routing_heatmap shows heavy concentration.

Jordan: quick check: any recent routing policy rollouts? I see a config push 18m ago to 'weighted-affinity' for canary traffic.

Ryan: that rollout included a tweak to prefer local-zone affinity (weight 0.8 -> 0.95). Could cause hot partitions if hash distribution uneven.

Alex: customers reporting streaming stalls (partial chunks) and prolonged reconnects. Need live mitigation: reduce affinity weight and fallback to balanced pools.

Maria: telemetry shows misroute_count increased: `router.misroute_rate{zone="us-west-2"}` jumped x7 at 2395001100. Also KV cache evictions on the affected shard spiked.

Lee: adding logs snippet from router host rtr-12:
```
[2395001123] route_eval: key=usr_abc123 -> policy=weighted-affinity -> chosen=shard-044 (load 0.92)
[2395001123] route_eval: fallback_check -> match=false -> forward to shard-044
[2395001124] stream_pipe: stall_detected -> recv_timeout 1200ms
[2395001125] metric_emit: misroute_event
```

Alex: plan: 1) set temp override to routing policy to balanced for us-west-2; 2) drain shard-044; 3) enable aggressive prefix caching for streaming; 4) notify customers. Anyone object?

Jordan: +1. I can apply override. I'll make the change as a scoped emergency flag. Command: `infractl routing set-override --zone=us-west-2 --policy=balanced --reason="hot-route tail spike"`

Ryan: after override, also watch backpressure on other shards. If we see increased p50 there, we may need to scale Dedicated pools or enable burst capacity.

Alex: executing now.

inc-bot: `infractl routing set-override` executed by Alex at 2395001201. Change id: OV-2026-289.

Maria: seeing immediate drop in misroute rate. p99 down from 1.35s -> ~820ms in 90s. Good signal but still above SLO.

Alex: proceeding to drain shard-044: annotate shard as 'draining' to redirect new sessions. `infractl shard drain shard-044 --zone=us-west-2`

inc-bot: shard-044 drain initiated by Alex at 2395001250.

Lee: started kv-cache flush on shard-044 to prevent stale prefix routing: `kvctl flush --shard shard-044` -> took ~12s.

Jordan: I've disabled the recent weighted-affinity rollout for the canary group (rollback trigger). Rollback id: RB-2026-72.

Maria: metrics now: p99 ~ 540ms, p95 ~ 370ms, streaming stall-rate reduced 85%. Looks like rollback + override + drain resolved most tail.

CustomerOps: gathering impact: preliminary: ~8 customers (internal & partner dev orgs) reported degraded streaming quality over last 20m; 2 customers escalated to SEs. Estimated error-free request loss ~0.6% of total traffic in us-west-2 during spike window.

Alex: good. We should keep override for 30m and monitor. If stable, demote to monitoring window, then remove override and re-evaluate routing logic.

Ryan: follow-ups: 1) root cause eval on why weighted-affinity caused hot shard bias (hash function/seed?), 2) add safety guard on rollout to cap per-shard weight delta, 3) add early warning for KV cache eviction rate. Assign to Jordan and Ryan.

Jordan: taking the routing investigation. I'll collect deterministic repro and load test against a replica cluster.

Alex: handoff: Jordan is taking lead for postmortem. On-call rotation: Jordan now primary. Alex will remain in channel for support.

Alex: closing live page if no regressions in next 30m. If anything pops, @here escalate.

inc-bot: Summary created: INC-2026-374. Tags: routing, misroute, tail-latency, us-west-2. Pager closed to on-call by Alex at 2395001589.

CustomerOps: emailed affected SEs and issued status update to customers at 2395001602. Draft: "We observed increased tail latency affecting streaming responses in us-west-2. We applied emergency routing overrides and rolled back a recent affinity rollout. Service is stable; we will follow up with a detailed postmortem."

Ryan: I'll open a follow-up RFC to propose rollout guardrails. Jordan -> please add timelines and repro artifacts to INC-2026-374.

Jordan: will do. ETA for postmortem draft tomorrow EOD. Action items assigned: Jordan (routing root cause), Ryan (rollout guardrails + alerting), Maria (metric dashboards: add kv-eviction alert), Lee (runbook update: draining steps + cache flush commands).

Alex: thanks team. final note: no evidence of data loss, only latency/stalls. Good job getting mitigation fast. :thumbsup:

CustomerOps: marked incident as "customer-notified" and created follow-up tickets for impacted SEs.

inc-bot: thread archived at 2395001789.
